<!-- pr-reviewer: bd09b68b5b45af896c34511bee83f149561a9f06 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge, after #501 (and #477 under it) lands.**

**What looks good**
- `sinumerik.cps` judges the safe Z once (`safeZ()`), covering all three outcomes in the description: a stated value (0 included) posts `G53 Z<v>`, no machine keeps `G53 Z0`, and a named machine that states nothing is refused with one message and no retract.
- When the retract is refused, the XY half of the home move is dropped as well, so XY never moves without the Z lift first.
- The stated value goes through the machine file's unit scaling. The `.mch` parser rejects a garbled or non-Z `safe_retract` by axis name, so it is not read as "unstated".
- The conformance goldens are byte-exact, and the PR adds no golden changes of its own. The two goldens my trial merge shows as added came from main.
- The new suite covers the null-machine and VMC path, a stated Z (mirror and raw-file doors, including the inch conversion), and a refused named machine, a "Siemens"-named one included.
- No build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes. No `CHANGELOG.md` edit. The decision file is in `docs/decisions/`.

**Local results** (trial merge with upstream/main was clean; worktree at the PR head plus main)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| build `camcraft-post` + `camcraft-app` tests | ok |
| app `sinumerik_safe_retract` | 3 passed |
| app `tormach_safe_retract` | 4 passed |
| app `tormach_post` | 10 passed |
| app `tormach_machines` | 5 passed |
| app `machine` | 32 passed |
| app `machine_library` | 11 passed |
| app `posting` | 17 passed |
| app `program_comments` | 4 passed |
| app `coolant` | 7 passed |
| app `coolant_followups` | 7 passed |
| app `conformance` (goldens) | 6 passed |
| app `after_op` | 10 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` | all green (3+9+3+33 tests) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. This PR contains #477's and #501's commits. Merge order #477, #501, then this one. Re-check that it still merges cleanly after #501 lands.
2. As the PR says, `millturn.mch` and any user machine without the key, plus pre-#495 documents with a mounted machine, are now refused by name through this post. That is the intended behaviour and is the maintainer's call, which the PR flags in its judgement calls.
3. `safeZ()` is fixed at the first call. The post engine runs one program per script load, so this is fine.

Not exercised here: a real machine and the Hub sim.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
